scope: Fresh standard macOS account installation and unpublished candidate update/rollback; no public release or version change
results: Downloaded the already published v0.1.10 installer, wheel and checksums as the standard account; both public assets matched SHA256SUMS. Installed managed Python, Node, OpenCode, oMLX and the pinned Qwen model into that account's separate home. No owner files or public release were changed.

The newly installed launcher reported KRYN 0.1.10. Deep doctor verified every pinned model SHA256, browser dependency files, native local routing and connected browser/search MCP. Doctor exited nonzero only because the account's oMLX runtime was not running.

Normal guarded bench could not start that account's oMLX app. A direct CLI retry reported that the account's app control socket did not exist. Only the owner account had an observable Finder/Dock GUI session and the second account's gui/505 launchd domain was unavailable. Thus end-to-end non-owner runtime remains unqualified.

Installed an unpublished same-version wheel from current main in the standard account. Its source revision became 60b1d25; KRYN rollback then restored the public e9c90ff revision. Post-rollback deep doctor again verified pinned model SHA256, browser files and native local routing. The runtime remained unavailable.

The signed app installer cache was restored by APFS clone from the owner's already verified cache for the candidate update; the local candidate wheel was not published. Final disk free was 40.25 GiB, above the 40 GiB reserve but too tight for additional large duplicate installations.
owner_restoration: The owner account's guarded private 65,536-token cff0f1b runtime was restarted. The last guarded protocol smoke passed; doctor reported healthy idle runtime, normal pressure, unchanged 415435325-byte swap, and connected browser/search MCP. One intervening smoke failed only the model's tool-first semantic answer (HTTP 200 and complete SSE, no tool call); it is retained as a quality failure, not erased by the later pass.
